sn9.6:1.1: On one occasion the Venerable Anuruddha was dwelling among the Kosalans in a certain woodland thicket.
sn9.6:1.2: Then a certain devatā of the Tāvatiṃsa host named Jālinī, a former consort of the Venerable Anuruddha, approached him and addressed him in verse
sn9.6:2.1: Direct your mind there [to that realm]
sn9.6:2.2: Where you dwelt in the past
sn9.6:2.4: For whom all desires are fulfilled.
sn9.6:2.5: You will shine forth highly honoured,
sn9.6:3.3: And miserable too are those beings,
sn9.6:4.3: The abode of the glorious male devas
sn9.6:4.4: Belonging to the host of Thirty.”
sn9.6:5.4: Their nature is to arise and vanish.
sn9.6:6.3: The wandering on in birth is ended:
sn9.6:6.4: Now there is no more renewed existence.”
